title: NFC North Mock Draft: Making picks ahead of Week 9
text:
2027 NFL Draft: NFC North mock picks ahead of Week 9 Schedule NFL News Draft Fantasy Odds Betting Newsletter VIKINGS NFC North Mock Draft: Making picks ahead of Week 9
 Andrew Harbaugh Vikings Wire Nov. 8, 2026, 8:55 a.m. CT With the ninth week of the NFL season now underway, we are locking back into one of our favorite series on Vikings Wire: NFC North Mock Drafts.
 Of course, Mock Draft Monday will still focus on the team itself, but what will the other teams in the division need come next April? We look at that and do three-round mock drafts for every team in the NFC North, not just the  Minnesota Vikings . By doing that, it accomplishes two things: the first is that fans get to know what the team needs and what the other opponents in the division have, but also, you get to know more names in college football.
 With that in mind, let's jump into the picks as we go through the uber-talented NFC North.
 Chicago Bears 
 Round 2: Sebastian Cheeks, Edge, Wisconsin
 Round 3: Qua Moss, CB, Tennessee
